newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX index firms slightly, blue chips mixed.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX index firms slightly, blue chips mixed.

text.p: Slovak blue chip shares were mixed in thin trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Thursday as the 16-share SAX index closed up 0.19 points at 167.95.
Steel maker VSZ, currently the market's most liquid issue, closed down three crowns at 647 while drug maker Slovakofarma rose 20 crowns to 4,200 to help boost the index.
Oil refinery Slovnaft, the most capitalised issue, did not match any deals on the automated market.
Overall, volume eased to 399,241 shares from 835,043 shares traded on Wednesday, while turnover fell to 180.1 million crowns, from 318.76 million.
